propositions: Live DC harness rendered-HTML assertions via ?expand=renderedFields prove markdown-to-wiki conversion (heading/bold/code-macro) renders correctly on Jira 8.17.1

State-based echo-safety holds end-to-end: a second reconcile pass after pushing a rich body computes zero inbound/outbound mutations (inbound differ recognizes Jira's rendered echo as unchanged via wire-form matching)

Both-sides concurrent edits enforce settled local-wins conflict policy: rebar-side + Jira-side description edits result in rebar's body landed AND a deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert with remote value preserved
InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text signature and behavior are pinned by a cross-repo contract test so breaking changes to the seam imported by agentic-dev-platform fail in rebar CI

Inbound differ echo-suppression now mirrors outbound via an injected OutboundMapper port and codec-aware wire-form matching (_description_forms) to suppress false inbound changes when Jira echoes the local body back
DC rich-text cutover must be enabled (REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=dc) in the harness subprocess environment for WikiTextCodec to convert markdown-to-wiki before push
